title_es: División recursiva por caracteres

title_es: Chunking por oraciones

title_es: Solapamiento por ventana deslizante

title_es: Semantic chunking por distancia entre embeddings
learning_objective: Your corpus has no headings or markup, topics shift mid-paragraph (call transcripts, scraped prose), and you can measure recall against a fixed-size baseline on your own queries.

migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Toma de notas estructurada como memoria externa
learning_objective: When the work will outlive one context window, or when an interruption would force the agent to re-derive what it already learned.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Aislamiento de contexto en subagentes
learning_objective: When a side task would fill the main window with search results, logs or file contents that the main agent will never read again.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Carga de contexto justo a tiempo
learning_objective: When you have 10 or more tools available, or when the definitions alone already consume more than 10k tokens before the model does any work.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Contexto largo frente a recuperación
learning_objective: Cross to retrieval once the answer-bearing slice is a tiny fraction of the corpus. Chroma's focused condition averaged about 300 tokens against a full input of about 113k, and every model scored higher on the focused one.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Workflow vs. agente
learning_objective: Pick a workflow when you can enumerate the subtasks before the first request; pick an agent only when the number of steps depends on input you have not seen yet.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Cadena de prompts
learning_objective: When the task decomposes cleanly into subtasks you can name in advance, and one call already returns output that is right in parts and wrong in others.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Enrutamiento
learning_objective: When your traffic has categories that measurably want different prompts, and you can classify them accurately enough that a misroute is rarer than the error you are removing.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Paralelización: seccionado
learning_objective: When the subtasks genuinely never read each other's output, and either wall-clock latency matters or a single call is visibly dropping one of the considerations you asked for.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Paralelización: votación
learning_objective: When the task has one right answer that different reasoning paths can reach independently, and you can afford several samples per response.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Orquestador-trabajadores
learning_objective: The subtasks cannot be listed before the request arrives, and the query is breadth-first: several independent directions, each worth its own 10-15 tool calls.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Evaluador-optimizador
learning_objective: You can write the grading criteria before generating anything, and a human articulating that same feedback would measurably improve the draft.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: El bucle autónomo de uso de herramientas
learning_objective: The number of steps depends on what the environment returns, and every step yields ground truth you can check, such as an exit code or a test result.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Asimetría de lectura y escritura entre agentes paralelos
learning_objective: Before you fan work out, ask whether two agents could touch the same file, row or branch. If they could, fan out the reads and keep the write on one path.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: You have not earned an agent yet
title_es: Todavía no te ganaste un agente
learning_objective: You cannot state today's pass rate on a fixed set of inputs. Then the next thing you build is the eval set, not the agent.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Tool use (llamada a funciones)
learning_objective: The answer depends on live state the prompt cannot hold (a current balance, a row in your database), or the turn has to produce an effect outside the conversation.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: The tool description is a prompt
title_es: La description de una tool es un prompt
learning_objective: The model picks the wrong tool, calls none at all, or fills a parameter oddly. Read the description before touching the system prompt or the model choice.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Los mensajes de error como prompt
learning_objective: The tool can fail for a reason the model could act on: a malformed argument, a rate limit, a result set too large, or a resource that must be created first.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Retornos de tool eficientes en tokens
learning_objective: A tool can return an unbounded set (log lines, search hits, table rows), or one agent run makes dozens of calls whose results all remain in context afterwards.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: MCP: qué estandariza
learning_objective: Reach for MCP when the same tool or data source must be reachable from more than one host application, so a bespoke per-host integration would get written twice.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Primitivas de MCP: tools, resources, prompts
learning_objective: Choose a tool when the model must decide to act, a resource when the host or user picks what enters context, and a prompt when a person triggers a named workflow.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Descubrimiento progresivo de herramientas
learning_objective: Turn it on when tool definitions pass roughly 10k tokens or 10 tools, and above all past 30 to 50 tools, where selection accuracy starts to degrade.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Ejecución de código como herramienta
learning_objective: Use it when a step's output is large and its only consumer is the next tool call, such as piping a meeting transcript out of Drive into a Salesforce record.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Prefill contra decode
learning_objective: When TTFT and inter-token latency do not tell the same story. Raise batch size: if throughput climbs while inter-token latency barely moves you are decode-bound, and if TTFT tracks prompt length you are prefill-bound.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: KV cache and its memory bill
title_es: KV cache y su factura de memoria
learning_objective: Before picking a GPU or fixing a max context length. Compute bytes per token from the model config, multiply by max_model_len times target concurrency, and check it fits in what is left after the weights.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Continuous batching (batching continuo)
learning_objective: When generated lengths vary across requests. Divide the longest generation in your traffic by the mean: that ratio approximates the fraction of GPU time static batching throws away.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: PagedAttention (atención paginada)
learning_objective: When memory profiling shows large reserved-but-unused KV space, or when several requests share a long prefix, which is the case for a fixed system prompt, parallel sampling and beam search.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Speculative decoding (decodificación especulativa)
learning_objective: Reach for it when inter-token latency is the complaint and the GPU sits memory-bound at low concurrency. vLLM names the target workload explicitly: "medium-to-low QPS (query per second), memory-bound workloads".
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Cuantización de pesos vs cuantización del KV cache
learning_objective: Quantize weights when the model barely fits on the card or when decode is bandwidth-bound in the weights. Quantize the KV cache when the scheduler is preempting and recomputing requests because KV blocks ran out.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: TTFT, inter-token latency and throughput as three separate goals
title_es: TTFT, latencia entre tokens y throughput como tres objetivos separados
learning_objective: Name the one your product is judged on before tuning anything. A chat surface is judged on TTFT and inter-token latency, a nightly extraction job only on tokens per second and dollars.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: Batch size as the latency/cost lever
title_es: El batch size como palanca de latencia y costo
learning_objective: Raise the batch bound while p99 TTFT still clears your target and preemptions stay at zero. Lower it the moment the scheduler starts recomputing preempted requests, which is the vLLM V1 default mode.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Respuestas en streaming
learning_objective: Stream whenever a human waits on the output, and whenever `max_tokens` is large enough that a single body would risk an HTTP timeout. The SDKs require streaming for large `max_tokens` for that reason.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Top 10 de OWASP para aplicaciones LLM (2025)
learning_objective: Reach for it when you scope a threat model for any system where model output can reach a tool call, a database, or another user, and give every one of the ten entries a named owner.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Inyección directa de prompt
learning_objective: Assume it whenever an untrusted person can reach the prompt field and that same session holds something they should not have: another tenant's rows, the system prompt text, or a tool credential.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Inyección indirecta de prompt
learning_objective: Assume it the moment a retrieved chunk, a fetched page, or a tool result the user did not author enters a context that can also call a tool with a side effect.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: Why prompt injection resists prompt-level defense
title_es: Por qué la inyección de prompt resiste las defensas a nivel de prompt
learning_objective: Bring this out when someone proposes to close an injection finding by editing the system prompt, or when a red-team report shows 0% attack success against a fixed file of attack strings.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: La tríada letal
learning_objective: Run the three-way check on every agent configuration before it ships: list the tools that read private data, the tools that ingest text an outsider can write, and the tools that emit bytes to a destination an outsider picks.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Canales de exfiltración
learning_objective: Enumerate the channels before shipping any surface that renders model output: markdown images, autolinked URLs, reference-style link definitions, link unfurling, iframes, and every tool that performs a write or a send.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Validación del lado de la salida
learning_objective: Whenever model output reaches something that interprets it: a browser DOM, a shell, a SQL driver, an email template, or a downstream extension holding privileges above the end user's.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: Agent sandboxing and least-privilege tool permissions
title_es: Sandboxing de agentes y permisos de herramientas con privilegio mínimo
learning_objective: When the agent runs code you did not read line by line, and you can name the directories and the domain list the task genuinely needs. If you cannot name them, you are not ready to auto-allow anything.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: Where the human belongs in the loop
title_es: Dónde va el humano en el ciclo
learning_objective: Put the gate on the last step that crosses a trust boundary, where the reviewer can still see the payload: the outbound send, the write to a shared system, the merge. Read-only steps do not earn a prompt.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: The prompt, RAG, fine-tune, distill decision rule
title_es: La regla de decisión entre prompt, RAG, fine-tuning y destilación
learning_objective: You have 20 or more labeled failures and can sort each one into 'the answer was never in the context' versus 'the context was right there and the output was still wrong'.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: LoRA (adaptación de rango bajo)
learning_objective: You need several task-specific variants of one base model, and paying full checkpoint size per variant does not fit your storage or your swap latency.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: QLoRA (LoRA sobre un base cuantizado a 4 bits)
learning_objective: The model you want to adapt does not fit your GPUs at 16 bits: a 65B model needs over 780GB for regular fine-tuning and under 48GB with QLoRA.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Fine-tuning completo
learning_objective: Continued pretraining on 10B or more tokens of a domain the base model barely saw, and only after a rank-256 adapter has been swept and still trails on your eval.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Ajuste por preferencias con DPO
learning_objective: You already have thousands of pairwise judgements on your own traffic, and supervised fine-tuning plateaued on a preference nobody can write down as a single target answer, such as tone or refusal style.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: Curating the fine-tune and eval sets
title_es: Curar los conjuntos de fine-tune y de evaluación
learning_objective: You can name the failing cases out loud, and you have fewer than 50 labelled examples of each one, so the next hour of work is collecting them rather than changing the model.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Enrutar entre niveles de modelo
learning_objective: Two tiers you would actually deploy differ by more than an order of magnitude in price, and you can measure a quality gap between them on your own set. The paper's pair was Mixtral 8x7B at about $0.24 against gpt-4-1106-preview at about $24.7 per million tokens.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Construir, comprar, abierto o cerrado
learning_objective: Your traffic is high and steady enough that reserved hours beat per-token billing, or a data-residency or latency requirement rules the hosted endpoint out before cost is even discussed.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_es: Costo por tarea resuelta
learning_objective: The system can retry. Any loop with a verifier, a judge, or a tool-calling agent, where the per-request price understates spend because failed attempts bill exactly like successful ones.
migration_notes: Codex is already reference-shaped; it stays the canonical layer.

title_en: Single tool-calling agent with a declared action surface
title_es: Agente único con llamada a herramientas y superficie de acciones declarada
learning_objective: You have one domain and a handful of operations, each describable by an OpenAPI schema or a function detail schema that names the parameters to elicit.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Magentic orchestrator with worker agents and a task ledger
title_es: Orquestador magentic con agentes trabajadores y un registro de tareas
learning_objective: Reach for it when a single agent cannot cover the task because of prompt complexity, tool overload or per-agent security boundaries, and a human needs to review the plan before or after it runs.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: MCP host, client and server topology
title_es: Topología de host, client y server en MCP
learning_objective: Use it when the same host has to speak to several context providers at once, some running locally over stdio and some remote over Streamable HTTP.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Continuous evaluation plane around a live agent (Microsoft Foundry)
title_es: Plano de evaluación continua alrededor de un agente en producción (Microsoft Foundry)
learning_objective: Reach for it when the agent already serves live traffic and you need scored samples of real responses, not only a pre-deployment test set.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: LoRA fine-tune training and serving pipeline (Azure OpenAI)
title_es: Pipeline de entrenamiento y servicio con fine-tuning LoRA (Azure OpenAI)
learning_objective: Reach for it once you have at least 10 well-formed training examples and prompt engineering has stopped improving the metric you care about.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Canary endpoint release with alarm-driven auto-rollback (SageMaker deployment guardrails)
title_es: Release de endpoint por canary con reversión automática por alarmas (guardrails de despliegue de SageMaker)
learning_objective: Reach for it when a real-time or asynchronous endpoint is already taking production traffic and you want the new fleet judged on live requests before it owns them all.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: LLM gateway with quotas, routing and audit
title_es: Gateway de LLM con cuotas, enrutamiento y auditoría
learning_objective: Several clients or teams share limited model capacity across multiple resources or regions, and you owe someone a per-client cost attribution plus faster visibility than Azure Monitor default metrics give.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Multitenant model platform with per-tenant isolation
title_es: Plataforma de modelos multitenant con aislamiento por tenant
learning_objective: You run a shared application tier for many tenants and a subset of them demand their own quota, their own content filtering policy, a fine-tuned model or a specific data residency.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Guardrail pipeline on the input and output paths
title_es: Pipeline de guardrails en las rutas de entrada y de salida
learning_objective: You need the same policy applied consistently across several foundation models, or you need to evaluate content with no model call at all through the ApplyGuardrail API.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Minimal managed RAG (Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases)
title_es: RAG gestionado mínimo (Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases)
learning_objective: You want the whole RAG workflow, from ingestion to retrieval and prompt augmentation, without writing custom integrations to your data sources, and one of the supported vector stores fits your constraints.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Production RAG with hybrid retrieval, reranking and a retrieval eval loop
title_es: RAG de producción con recuperación híbrida, reranking y ciclo de evaluación
learning_objective: You ran hybrid or multiple searches, or you deliberately retrieved a large candidate set such as top 50 instead of top 10, and answer quality matters more to you than the extra latency.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Agentic retrieval: LLM query planning over a knowledge base
title_es: Recuperación agéntica: planificación de consultas con LLM sobre una knowledge base
learning_objective: Reach for it when questions carry multiple asks, depend on earlier turns of the conversation, or arrive with spelling mistakes that a single vector query would miss.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: Event-driven RAG ingestion: object storage to pgvector
title_es: Ingesta RAG por eventos: del almacenamiento de objetos a pgvector
learning_objective: Use it when new files land continuously in a bucket and you want indexing to happen per upload rather than in a nightly batch job.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_en: GraphRAG: knowledge graph with community summaries
title_es: GraphRAG: grafo de conocimiento con resúmenes de comunidades
learning_objective: Reach for it when questions ask about themes across the entire corpus, or need facts linked by a shared attribute that no single chunk contains, over private data the model never saw in training.
migration_notes: Vendor-sourced reference shape; needs the §38.3 view split when promoted.

title_es: Escala una capa web con muchas lecturas
learning_objective: Reads dominate 20:1. Assemble a tier that scales out horizontally: put stateless app servers behind a load balancer, add a cache in front of the database, and keep sessions out of the app servers.
migration_notes: Already a §6.4 Architecture Assembly lab.
